source_text:
Title: Lasagna alla Bolognese with meat ragù and creamy béchamel
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Meat Ragù | 400 g | beef ground beef |  | 000011
- Meat Ragù | 200 g | pork ground pork |  | 000035
- Meat Ragù | 100 g | onion |  | 000111
- Meat Ragù | 10 g | garlic |  | 000112
- Meat Ragù | 80 g | carrots |  | 000069
- Meat Ragù | 80 g | celery |  | 000117
- Meat Ragù | 800 g | canned tomatoes |  | 000415
- Meat Ragù | 150 ml | red wine |  | 000572
- Meat Ragù | 1 pcs | Beef Stock, Cube |  | 000639
- Meat Ragù | 30 ml | olive oil |  | 000378
- Meat Ragù | 1 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Meat Ragù | 0.5 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Creamy Béchamel | 50 g | unsalted butter |  | 000212
- Creamy Béchamel | 50 g | all-purpose flour |  | 000348
- Creamy Béchamel | 750 ml | whole milk |  | 000182
- Creamy Béchamel | 0.25 tsp | ground nutmeg |  | 000283
- Creamy Béchamel | 0.5 tsp | table salt |  | 000292
- Pasta Assembly | 250 g | lasagna sheets |  | 000327
- Pasta Assembly | 100 g | parmesan |  | 000196

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Meat Ragù | Prep |  | Finely dice the onion, carrot, and celery. Mince the garlic cloves.
2. Creamy Béchamel | Prep |  | Measure out the butter, flour, and milk. Pre-heat the milk slightly in a separate pan or microwave.
3. Pasta Assembly | Prep |  | Preheat the oven to 180°C and finely grate the Parmigiano-Reggiano.
4. Meat Ragù | Cook |  | Heat olive oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat and sauté the onion, carrot, and celery until softened.
5. Creamy Béchamel | Cook |  | Melt the unsalted butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat.
6. Pasta Assembly | Prep |  | Lightly grease a rectangular baking dish with butter or oil.
7. Meat Ragù | Cook |  | Add the ground beef and ground pork. SAFE HANDLING: Ensure raw meat is cooked thoroughly until browned and handle raw juices with care by washing hands and tools immediately.
8. Creamy Béchamel | Cook |  | Whisk in the all-purpose flour to form a roux and cook for 2 minutes while stirring constantly to avoid browning.
9. Pasta Assembly | Cook |  | Spread a few spoonfuls of Meat Ragù over the bottom of the dish to prevent the pasta from sticking.
10. Meat Ragù | Cook |  | Pour in the red wine to deglaze the pot, scraping up any browned bits, and simmer until the liquid is reduced by half.
11. Creamy Béchamel | Cook |  | Slowly add a small amount of warm milk, whisking vigorously to incorporate and remove any lumps.
12. Pasta Assembly | Cook |  | Place a layer of lasagna sheets over the sauce, trimming edges if necessary to fit the dish.
13. Meat Ragù | Cook |  | Add the canned tomatoes and the beef stock cube dissolved in 100ml of hot water.
14. Creamy Béchamel | Cook |  | Continue adding the milk in stages, whisking continuously until the mixture is smooth and begins to thicken.
15. Pasta Assembly | Cook |  | Add a layer of ragù, followed by a layer of Creamy Béchamel, and a sprinkle of Parmigiano-Reggiano.
16. Meat Ragù | Cook |  | Stir in the minced garlic, salt, and black pepper. Lower the heat and simmer gently for at least 90 minutes.
17. Creamy Béchamel | Cook |  | Simmer the sauce for 5-7 minutes until it reaches a velvety, coat-the-back-of-a-spoon consistency.
18. Pasta Assembly | Cook |  | Repeat the layers (pasta, ragù, béchamel, cheese) until all ingredients are used, ending with a final layer of béchamel.
19. Meat Ragù | Cook |  | Check the ragù consistency; it should be thick and rich. Adjust seasoning if necessary.
20. Creamy Béchamel | Cook |  | Season with ground nutmeg and salt. Remove from heat.
21. Pasta Assembly | Cook |  | Top generously with the remaining Parmigiano-Reggiano to create a golden crust.
22. Meat Ragù | Serve |  | Keep warm until ready to assemble the lasagna layers.
23. Creamy Béchamel | Prep |  | Cover the surface with plastic wrap to prevent a skin from forming as it cools slightly.
24. Pasta Assembly | Cook |  | Bake in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes until the top is bubbling and deep golden brown.
25. Pasta Assembly | Serve |  | Remove from the oven and let rest for 15 minutes before slicing to ensure the layers stay intact.
